document.abstract: This standard specifies the frequency response and operating level for recorders and reproducers for audio 1 record for 2-in quadruplex video magnetic tape recording at 15 in/s and 7.5 in/s (381 mm/s and 190.5 mm/s), as defined in ANSI/SMPTE 6. It also specifies the field method of calibration of recorders and reproducers, utilizing the test tapes as defined in ANSI/SMPTE 8 and ANSI/SMPTE 11.
